title: Could you tell me where it is?

options.text: Could you tell me where the exit is?
Could you tell me where is the exit?

correct.title: That’s right
correct.message: Keep subject + verb inside the embedded question. Correct: Could you tell me where the exit is?

wrong.title: Check the grammar
wrong.message: Keep subject + verb inside the embedded question. Correct: Could you tell me where the exit is?

options.text: Do you know if the tour is included?
Do you know if is the tour included?

correct.title: That’s right
correct.message: After if, use statement order: the tour is. Correct: Do you know if the tour is included?

wrong.title: Check the grammar
wrong.message: After if, use statement order: the tour is. Correct: Do you know if the tour is included?

options.text: Do you know when does the museum close?
Do you know when the museum closes?

correct.title: That’s right
correct.message: Use when + subject + verb inside the question; do not add does. Correct: Do you know when the museum closes?

wrong.title: Check the grammar
wrong.message: Use when + subject + verb inside the question; do not add does. Correct: Do you know when the museum closes?

correct.title: That’s right
correct.message: A direct question puts is before the subject. Correct: Where is the cloakroom?

wrong.title: Check the grammar
wrong.message: A direct question puts is before the subject. Correct: Where is the cloakroom?

options.text: Could you tell me where I can leave my bag?
Could you tell me where can I leave my bag?

correct.title: That’s right
correct.message: Inside the embedded question, put I before can. Correct: Could you tell me where I can leave my bag?

wrong.title: Check the grammar
wrong.message: Inside the embedded question, put I before can. Correct: Could you tell me where I can leave my bag?

options.text: Do you know if are tickets available?
Do you know if tickets are available?

correct.title: That’s right
correct.message: Keep tickets are after if. Correct: Do you know if tickets are available?

wrong.title: Check the grammar
wrong.message: Keep tickets are after if. Correct: Do you know if tickets are available?

phrases.displayText: Could you tell me where the guided tour starts?
phrases.translation: Pode me dizer onde começa a visita guiada?

phrases.displayText: At the reception desk at ten. The talk is later, at eleven thirty
phrases.translation: Na recepção às dez. A palestra é depois, às onze e meia

phrases.displayText: Do you know if the tour is included in the entrance fee?
phrases.translation: Você sabe se a visita está incluída no ingresso?

phrases.displayText: The standard tour is included. The special workshop costs extra
phrases.translation: A visita normal está incluída. A oficina especial custa à parte

phrases.displayText: Thanks. Could you tell me where I can leave my bag?
phrases.translation: Obrigada. Pode me dizer onde posso deixar minha bolsa?

phrases.displayText: There’s a cloakroom on the ground floor, beside the information point
phrases.translation: Tem um guarda-volumes no térreo, ao lado do ponto de informações

phrases.displayText: And is the talk still in room two?
phrases.translation: E a palestra continua na sala dois?

phrases.displayText: That’s what the timetable says. Please check the board before you go
phrases.translation: É o que diz a programação. Confira o quadro antes de ir
